description: The brand’s AppLovin Ads campaigns: id, name, LIVE/PAUSED, daily budget, goal, countries, landing page. Rename or edit one with update_applovin_ads_campaign; pause or go live with set_applovin_ads_status. Read-only, free. Needs the Campaign Management key, which exists once AppLovin enables API access on the account; without it the answer says how to get it.
name: list_applovin_ads_campaigns
title: List AppLovin Ads campaigns
